messages:
Jamal: hey all, Jamal here — first day on infra. quick set of newbie q's: who is the contact for getting prod deploy perms, where's the svc-owner list, and what's the escalation lane if I ever hit a pager?

Marco: welcome Jamal! :tada: short answers — deploy perms are owned by Eng Platform, svc-owner mapping lives in the service OWNERS file + our internal ownership UI, and escalation is: service owner -> platform -> oncall -> SRE lead.

Jamal: thanks. where do I open the initial access request?

People Ops Bot: Hi Jamal — please open a ticket at https://people-ops.redwood/tickets with subject "Access: deploy + k8s". Template will ask for GitHub handle, employee ID, and justification.

Sophia: @Jamal I can fast-track RBAC and add you to the dev namespace. DM me your GH handle and the ticket number once created. Also, for k8s CLI access run: `kubectl config view --minify` after we add your creds.

Jamal: got it. I created ticket #4897. tagged Sophia.

Kelly: for pagers — read the oncall playbook: https://confluence.redwood.com/playbooks/oncall. TL;DR: acknowledge within 5m, try the owner contact in OWNERS, then escalate to platform if the owner is unreachable. If it's SEV, follow the SEV runbook and call out SRE lead.

Jamal: where exactly is the OWNERS file? repo-per-service or centralized?

Marco: both. Each service repo has an OWNERS file at the root. We also mirror a consolidated view in https://infra.redwood/ownership (read-only for new hires until you get perms).

Alex: ps — for quick local dev and to avoid accidental prod hits, use the staging cluster `stg-<your-github>` and prefix any terraform work with `-var=env=staging`. saved me once :grimacing:.

Jamal: I'm blocked on Vault 2FA enrollment (no YubiKey yet). any tips for remote folks?

Sophia: we ship YubiKeys. If you're remote, open a support request to security and include your mailing address; they ship next-day. If urgent, security can provide temporary OTP via Okta for 24h.

Jamal: perfect, will do. one more — who owns the incident postmortem process? want to know who to loop in when we file one.

Kelly: the incident runner (usually the SRE oncall) is responsible for kicking off the postmortem and assigning owners. For training, reach out to me or @Marco and we'll walk you through the template.

Jamal: awesome, thanks everyone. super helpful.

Marco: welcome again! drop any follow-ups here. if you want a quick walkthrough, I can jump on a 15m call later. :phone:

Jamal: I'll take that — 3pm works for me.

People Ops Bot: Ticket 4897 status updated: awaiting-approval -> approved.

Jamal: approved — cool. thanks y'all :pray:
summary: new hire asks who to contact for deploy perms, ownership maps, and escalation lanes; team points to OWNERS files, infra UI, people-ops ticket, playbook, and offers fast-tracking and YubiKey shipping info
